verdict.rationale: Langfuse exposes datasets, experiments, and evaluation (LLM-as-a-Judge, code evaluators) via SDK/API, and offers a Metrics/Query API plus an MCP server, so an agent could plausibly create datasets, run experiments, and query results programmatically. However, evidence emphasizes UI-based experiment workflows and doesn't explicitly confirm a full programmatic dataset-creation-to-eval-results loop, and community feedback notes slow/bulky retrieval APIs and rough edges in tooling.
